title.narrative: Brazilian States and Municipalities Digital Acceleration Project

description.narrative: Expand financing to increase access to and inclusive use of broadband internet and digital government services in Brazil's underserved states and municipalities

The main objective of this project is to provide financing and technical assistance to Brazilian states and cities to promote the digital transformation of public services, improving efficiency and accessibility for citizens, especially the most vulnerable, and companies.CAIXA is present throughout the country, and due to its capillarity, it serves practically all Brazilian cities. CAIXA provides an exclusive space for public entities to present their demands for projects and needs to advance digital transformation.The program aims to fill the funding gap to promote digital transformation in states and cities. This will be achieved by offering federal and municipal entities lines of credit and technical assistance for Digital Public Infrastructure, Digital Transformation of theService Charter and Digital Capacity.Credit operations will be made available according to the applicant's needs, by submitting investment projects. These applications will be analyzed considering credit risk and economic and financial viability.
